description: React component implementing a Tic Tac Toe game with game logic, AI move calculation, UI rendering, and game state management.

methods.name: checkWinner
methods.description: Checks the game board for a winner or a draw, returning the result object or null.

methods.name: getAvailableMoves
methods.description: Returns an array of indices of empty cells on the board.

methods.name: computeAIMove
methods.description: Determines the AI's move based on simple heuristics: winning, blocking, center, corner, or random.
